notes.title: Patch v11.20
notes.content:
[p]//misc changes
- Campaign Reconnexus game mode: When playing on Argon Difficulty for the first time there's now an intro text (to better explain the game mode's mechanics).
- Campaign Reconnexus game mode: The Core Dealer icon now has a bit of colour (so it's easy to see if a Core is available).

//bug fixes
- Choose Game Mode: The Win Gems for the Survival Function and Campaign Reconnexus game modes were switched around.
- Choose Difficulty - Nightmare Mode: If you had Nightmare mode turned on for the Survival Function game mode in a previous version of the game then updated the game then it could have Nightmare mode turned on in the Campaign Reconnexus game mode despite it being locked (leaving with you no way to turn it off until you unlocked it).
- Shops: When restocking a weapon that was a free upgrade the restocked item could also be offered for free.
- Shops: When restocking a weapon it could offer an upgrade that the shop is already selling (which could take it above level 3).
- Classious Heirloom stranger: It could offer a Mega Element class item that was useless in that Difficulty.
- Balliston Belcher enemy: It was ignoring the Flee status effect (it will now despawn when offscreen).[/p]

notes.title: Patch v11.19
notes.content:
//misc changes
- The smallest font has had some tweaks (so is easier to read).
- Settings - Fullscaling: Its resolution can now go up to x14 (from x7).
- Menus: The borders on currently selected icons have been brightened (so it's more obvious when not using mouse input).
- Choose Game Mode menu: The Survival Function and Campaign Reconnexus game modes have swapped places (so the unlock process has less of a Difficulty spike).
- Rogue Convergence: A Class Heritage shop will now also show just before the Boss (to create a bit more difference between classes).
- Survival Function / Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 1 Bosses: Their starting Health have been slightly reduced (since they need to be beaten to unlock other game modes).
- Campaign Reconnexus: A Class Heritage shop will now also show in the end Element shops (to create a bit more difference between classes).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 1 - Boss: The amount of attacks he fires has been tuned down slightly, especially when he has more than 50% Health (so less of a Difficulty spike). 
- Compendium - Bestiary: The Systemous Masterorium bosses now have bigger example sprites (so look cooler than the regular Custodian boss).
- Star Devourer weapon: Their projectile will no longer do damage until it's fully grown (otherwise it can look like it doesn't spawn at all if it spawns on a powerful enemy).
- Eggcellent Eggy class: He will no longer randomise your Voids Vigil weapon (since would be pointless buying them).
- Player Drones: Their default blue colours have been tweaked (so they look less like you for better visibility).
- Guardum Drone: Their blue shield bubble colour has been tweaked (so they look less like regular interact bubbles for better visibility).
- Voidmare Skullion enemy: When destroyed they now spawn 1-3 regular Skullions.

//bug fixes
- Choose Difficulty menu: The hover sprite was incorrect if you haven't yet beaten that Difficulty.
- Lure Mineus: If the current theme is Emeralt then they would also spawn a background sprite (which would look messy in long Survival runs).
- Lazumi Missileer enemy: There was a chance its laser attack could remain even after it was destroyed.

notes.title: Patch v11.18
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Voidworld Trials: You now start with a special Stash item which when hovered over shows the current Trial Traits (so they can be seen mid-run).
- Rogue Convergence - Encrypted Stranger - Malware Environeer: This event can now appear just before the End Boss.
- If you were killed by King Gigald then it now says "pounded by" (instead of "killed by").

//bug fixes
- Rogue Convergence - Difficulty 6 - End Boss: A few of the Mini Eyes were in the slightly wrong position.
- Rogue Convergence - Difficulty 6 - End Boss: The laser beam that was mirrored off the screen was doing a lot more damage than the base laser.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 1 - Map: There was a rare chance for part of the map to be inaccessible.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 6 - End Boss: The laser beam that was mirrored off the screen was doing a lot more damage than the base laser.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map Screen: There was a rare chance that the path to a Dormant Radar may be cut off (they now can't spawn at the very edge of a map).
- Voidworld Trials: After beating the End Boss in a Rogue/Campaign it could spawn the Survival Beacon.
- Voidworld Trials: In a Rogue Convergence the special rooms in each successive level could often be the same.
- Voidworld Trials: Some trials that give a random bonus at the start of a level weren't being consistent between runs.
- Mega Spawn Beacon: Its spawn message was wrongly calling it a "Giga Spawn Beacon".
- Stable weapon trait: Some attack life spans were lasting forever (instead of twice as long).
- Snekouss enemy: Its tail Elementful/Elementless status effect sometimes wasn't consistent with its head.

notes.title: Patch v11.17
notes.content:
//misc changes
- There's now a "Voids Vigil 100%" achievement for getting all other achievements (in case you want to show it off on your profile).
- Mental Alchemistal class unlock: Elementless and Elementful weapons now count for purposes of having the 5 different element weapons.

//bug fixes
- Game Over - Compendium - Campaign Survival: When viewing the leaderboard it wasn't showing any scores.
- Compendium - Leaderboards - Campaign Reconnexus: The Campaign Survival button wasn't being shown.
- Nightmare Mode: Some enemies that spawned during Boss fights were giving Score.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Nightmare Mode: During the end Boss fight in some Difficulties the spawn gate could endlessly spawn enemies.
- Dark Metaman - In Survival Function his Metaman Cog Data class item description could show a decimal amount.

notes.title: Patch v11.16
notes.content:
//misc changes
- The game has been updated to the latest version of GameMaker (v2024.13).
- Campaign Reconnexus game mode - Map Screen: If you hover over an icon that's revealed but you can't yet reach then it now says "path required" where the travel tip usually is.
- Shops: If you don't have enough Cogs to buy an item then its cost is now shown in red.
- Shops Screen: When using a gamepad the Re-roll panel border now uses a brighter version (so it's the same as the Shop borders).
- Blacksmith Forger class: His class trait now allows him to upgrade Weapons/Abilities/Drones into the appropriate Mega item.
- Mimic Mouldmaker class: They will no longer be offered the Mega Element weapon class items if that weapon's element wouldn't show in the Difficulty (as they are useless).

//bug fixes
- Choose Game Mode menu: The Campaign Reconnexus gems for beating the game mode weren't showing.
- Shops Screen: When using a gamepad if all Shops were removed due to Corrupted Signals then the selector was scuffed.
- Shops Screen: When using a gamepad with the Re-roll currently selected then you couldn't press Down to go to Continue.
- Shops Screen: When using a gamepad if a temporary Shop is removed then the bottom text wasn't immediately updating.
- Dodgy Networker class: In a Campaign Reconnexus the Contract Dealer could trigger a Contact Broker or Trojan Signal event.
- Specialous Sectorium passive item: There was a chance it wouldn't add the extra special room if it was a special sector.
- Gunineer Servomegatron drone: There was a chance of it having a normal weapon if you had any Elementless weapons.
- Gunineer Servomegatron drone: There was a rare chance of it having a Voids Vigil weapon.
- Abilitum Installer shop: The Mega Ability background panel looked scuffed if you had more than 5 Mega Abilities.
- Encrypted Stranger - Abilitious Specialty: In a Campaign Reconnexus he could give a Mega Ability you already have.

notes.title: Patch v11.15
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Title Screen - Choose Difficulty menu: The Nightmare Win gems now use the same colours as the Difficulty element (instead of all being blue).
- When hacking an interactor the brightness of the interaction circle is now increased (so it's easier to notice).
- Dark Metaman class: It now shows its exact class bonuses when choosing a class or viewing them in the Status Screen.
- Automised Upgrader sector room: It now can't spawn in sector 0 (since there's a good chance you won't have anything to upgrade).

//bug fixes
- Choose Starting Weapon: In Nightmare Mode choosing Fortuity Destiny as a second weapon wasn't working correctly.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Dormant Radar: It was possible for it to contain only 1 Datarium Bank.
- Gun Runner shop: When using a gamepad there was a rare chance of a crash.
- Gun Runner shop: When offering a mega weapon if both scrapped weapons were the same and you sold one then you could still buy the mega weapon.
- Salvage Stripper class: When using a gamepad Salvaging an item that is not on the first page would Salvage the wrong item.
- Scav Junker shop: If you bought a Drone but had already reached max Drones then it would waste your Cogs.
- Swollen Balls ability: It was using the Player Attack Alpha setting.
- Traitful weapon trait: It could give the Chemistry trait which didn't do anything.

notes.title: Patch v11.14
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Mineire enemy: The exploding Emeralt variant that doesn't move now ignores the Knockback trait (as it looked weird).

//bug fixes
- Status Screen - Gear: The button to change Stash Page was the same as used to Salvage an item or change a Weapon's Element via Atom.
- Orbilas Kindle class: It could be offered the Aggressive Kindle passive item.
- Eggcellent Eggy class: When randomising your weapon it was ignoring the Chemistry Traitum.
- Ethereal Eternal class: Its unlock text was wrongly saying it could only be unlocked in Rogue Convergence.
- Occultist Drone: If a Boss was within its aura then it would keep creating the smoke effect.
- Cursed Shard ability: If a Boss was within its aura then it would keep creating the smoke effect.
- Store Restockments passive item: When re-stocking a weapon it was ignoring the Chemistry Traitum.
- Mineire enemy: In Emeralt sectors the hazard version could sometimes not be the exploding variant.

notes.title: Patch v11.13
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 7: It now has an extra 4 Dormant Sectors (to give a bit more choice when leveling up).
- Orbilas Kindle class: Its class items now have more explanative descriptions.
- Gun Runner Shop: The cost of weapon upgrades has been reduced to 20 (from 25).
- Store Restockments passive item: When buying a weapon upgrade the chance for the restocked item to also be an upgrade has been reduced to 50% (from 66%).
- Voidal Snap ability: Its icon has changed as it was too similar to Chronos Relapse.

//bug fixes
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: There was a chance for some map icons to change position if you've reached beyond Sector 13 or have a lot of Drones.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 6: It was possible to elementally cut off the Vulium region and some Argon icons.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Dormant Arena: It wasn't creating a Treasure Chest room if you had the Ruinous Runner passive item or was playing as the Salvage Stripper class.
- Dark Metaman class: When working out its starting boosts it was only counting Wins for the same Difficulty once.
- Gun Runner shop: There was a rare chance of a crash when entering it.
- Gun Runner shop: If you could be offered more than 2 Mega weapons then it would just offer the same two.
- Schematic Engraver shop: You could still buy a Mega Trait upgrade if you don't currently have the weapon.
- Ruinous Runner passive item: When fighting a Vulium End Boss the Darkness layer would look funky.
- Pristine Traitum - Gun Runner shop: Upgrades for Mega Weapons were showing as empty slots.

notes.title: Patch v11.12
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Campaign Reconnexus: Dormant Radars will now always show on the map (to give you something to work towards).
- Campaign Reconnexus: The Sanctum Conservator Bosses now drop Cogs upon their death (so there's a reason to kill them earlier on).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 7: In the Argon map region one of the regular Stranger events has been replaced with a Dormant Sector (to make the start easier).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 7: You now start with +1 Power Core but there's now one less Core Seller on the Map (to give extra cogs).

//bug fixes
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map - Gun Runner Shop: You could only be offered the Voids Vigil weapon in one Shop at a time.
- Schematic Engraver shop: You could Seal/Banish Mega Trait upgrades.
- Sealmentus Staff passive item: When sealing items in the Device Repository it could sometimes offer the wrong item in the next Shop.
- Encrypted Stranger - Gimme Dat: Selling some items could create issues and wasn't immediately updating variables and stat modifiers.

notes.title: Patch v11.11
notes.content:
//misc changes
- All weapons now have +20% vision range during Boss fights (so you don't have to be quite so close to attack).
- Gun Runner Shop: This will now always show if the Sector number is less than 3 (as not being offered weapons early on was annoying).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 7: There's now an extra Green or Blue Sector (so you have a bit more options before heading to the end sectors).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 7 - Map: The first Dormant Radar now has bit extra Cog value (since the start can be very rough depending on the map).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: Dormant Radars must now always be connected in a cardinal direction to an icon of the same Element (so can't be elementally cut off).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: The cost of the 'X Marks The Spot' Stranger event has been reduced to 11-33 (from 69). The Treasure Sector's Cog value has increased by +11% and Score Value has increased by +22%.
- Shops: When not using Mouse Input the selected Shop border colour is now brighter (so easier to see).

//bug fixes
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: Visiting multiple different Shop Emporiums could allow you to bypass the Mega/Giga weapon limit.
- Campaign Reconnexus - End Boss: A part of the body and debris could be the wrong colour.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Dodgy Networker class: Re-entering a Shop Emporium wouldn't have a Contract Dealer.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Dodgy Networker class: If the Contract Dealer triggered a Coupon Cracker event then the Shops in that Emporium wouldn't have sales.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Dodgy Networker class: Regular Encrypted Strangers couldn't have a Contact Broker or Trojan Signal event.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Shops: The Weapon/Ability/Drone Fortuity Shipment items weren't being offered.
- Campaign Reconnexus: Encrypted Stranger - Triggering a Coupon Cracker event could cause a crash.
- Astro Starstorm weapons: It could have a reduced vision range during Boss fights.
- Bodily Bolster / Data Overload abilities: They could be triggered during Boss fights.

notes.title: Patch v11.10
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: The different element Shop Emporiums now have their own separate re-roll cost (so every Shop is useful).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: Dormant Radars will now always connect to nearby icons (so they can't be elementally cut-off).
- Dodgy Networker class: He now gets 3-6 Cogs for each successful Hack.
- Vampire Survivor class: The HUD now shows an icon in the bottom right if a Techarcana Card is active (mainly just of use in the Survival Function game mode).
- Snekouss Mk1 enemy: The speed of the projectiles it creates when destroyed has been reduced.
- Lure Nukem/Glider/Balliston abilities: The amount of enemies they spawn has been reduced to 2-4 (from 3-6) and their cost reduced to 30 (from 35).
- Sawblade Whirler passive item: It's sprite is now a bit bigger and looks better.

//bug fixes
- Element Bearer class: If they played a Difficulty that doesn't contain its Element then they couldn't be offered a Core that was.
- Pussy Purrer class: They could be offered the Medical Servo drone, Healing Winds and Data Overload abilities (which don't really work with the class).
- Data Sync passive item: Hacking into the End Boss's Survival Beacon would trigger this item.
- Lure Lazumi ability: Its description was wrong.
- Droneous Eggling mega ability: It was spawning a Level 1 drone (instead of Level 3).

notes.title: Patch v11.9
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Survival Function: When gaining a new sector item/upgrade (eg Blacksmith class) it will now show them in the top left (like how the other game modes do).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 7 - Map: The default Element layout has been adjusted so there's more of a natural progression (eg there's now no Elementless sectors near the start).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 7 - Map: Elements must now have a normal Sector before it can have an Arena (so less difficulty spikes).
- Encrypted Stranger - Gimme Dat: The chance of him wanting to buy a Traitum item has been greatly reduced (since it was probably blueprinted).
- Abilitum Drones: Their Abilities are now randomised each time they trigger one (instead of being set at the start of the sector).
- Abilitum Drones: The chance for them to trigger an Enemy Lure ability has been reduced by 22%
- Plump Nukem enemy: The speed of the projectiles it creates when destroyed has been reduced.
- Boboom Mk Mega enemy: The speed of the projectiles it creates when destroyed has been reduced.

//bug fixes
- Campaign Reconnexus - Class Heritage shop: It could offer a passive item that you may have already gotten from elsewhere.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Elementalist shop: You could buy multiple different element Cores if you visited multiple shops before buying one.
- Sector event - Extra Darkness: The visual effects from killed enemies were showing above the Darkness layer.
- Abilitary Connoisseur class: Entering the Abilitum Installer shop could cause a crash.
- Buzz Droids ability: Triggering this ability could cause a crash.
- Abilitum Drones: During a boss fight if they attempted to trigger a resource related ability then nothing would trigger.

notes.title: Patch v11.8
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Improved performance if there's a lot of enemies.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 7: The chance of starting near Argon Sectors has been greatly increased (as the starts were often very rough).
- Encrypted Stranger - Distilled Bodiliser: It now shows the stats that will be affected at the bottom.

//bug fixes
- Shops: The Master Baiter, Transmission Router, and Bionica Ripperdoc shops were unable to be On Sale.
- Melee/Gas Weapons and some Mega Weapons weren't benefitting from the Blast/Flux/Voltage traits.

notes.title: Patch v11.7
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Rogue/Campaign - Difficulty 4 - End Boss - The amount of time the swirling balls remain active has been reduced by 20%.
- Elementless Generator passive item: Its cost has been reduced to 20 (from 25).
- Bionic Ripperdoc: Its item costs are now 10-20 (instead of 10) with the costs partially being based on the Stat boost amount.
- Encrypted Stranger - Exotical Nanisseur: Its cost has been reduced to 10-20 (from 20-40).

//bug fixes
- Rogue Convergence - Difficulty 7 - End Boss: The length of some attacks were often too short or too long.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 3-5 - Map: There was a chance the second Dormant Radar would be inaccessible.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: Beating a Dormant Arena would sometimes not activate icons that were diagonally next to it.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: After winning a Dormant Arena the sector info text would still show when hovering over the icon.
- Rogue/Campaign - End Boss - Survival Challenge interact: This could show even if that was the first time you had beaten that Difficulty.
- Elementful Exhaust passive item: It wasn't boosting Element stats that don't usually appear in that Difficulty's Elements.
- Elementless Generator passive item: It wasn't boosting Element stats that don't usually appear in that Difficulty's Elements.
- Mega Trigger trait item: Its description text was too long for the screen.
- Medical/Guardum drones: Their auras were too bright if you have a high Drone Alpha visibility setting.
- Booty Hauler: If you were hacking it as the sector exit portal was opening then the hacking text would remain visible.
- Enemies: They could still be killed by status effects if they are offscreen with the sector exit portal open.

notes.title: Patch v11.6
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: On larger maps when using the Mouse it now shows a Scroll button tip in the top-left and no longer scrolls by moving the mouse to the sides of the screen.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Shops: The element specific shops will now always show in their respective element shop (eg Master Baiter).
- Shops: When visiting a Shop with a sale on it will now say what the sale is in the top-left.
- Ionic Lazcannon weapon: Its laser beam is now less bright.

//bug fixes
- Shops: Re-rolling the Shop when you have every passive item would cause a hard freeze.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Sanctum Conservator: Killing it could spawn the Campaign Survival beacon.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: The Coupon Cracker stranger event wasn't giving Sales.
- Enfeebled Watcher class: This could be unlocked at the end of a sector.
- Bodily Bolster ability: This could be used during Boss fights.
- Ionic Lazcannon weapon: It wasn't benefitting from the Bulge trait.
- Flux weapon trait: The Flux clouds were being almost instantly destroyed.
- Snekouss enemy: Its tail was being treated separately when suffering Curse status.

notes.title: Patch v11.5
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: A new event has been added called the Stranger Collective which houses several Encrypted Stranger events (to add more randomness to the lower Difficulties).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: Core Dealers now have their own icons (so are easy to keep track of).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: The first Dormant Radar now has an extra +25% Cog value (so you have more to spend at the first shop).
- Rogue Survival: Swarm enemies will attempt to push themselves out of each other more (so there's less of a big clump in the middle).

//bug fixes
- Compendium - Bestiary: Killing the Masterorium wasn't updating the Bestiary.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: In later Difficulties it sometimes wasn't spawning all of the Core Dealer events.
- When opening the Choose Weapon menu there was a chance of it crashing.
- Booting up the game could cause a crash if you were using a save file from Early Access.
- Shops: They could sometimes not offer a Mega Traitum.
- The game's window title could sometimes change from "Voids Vigil".

notes.title: Patch v11.4
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Settings - Resolution: 2 new resolutions have been added: 2560x1440, 3840x2160.
- The enemy health reduction in Sector 0 has been increased to 30% (from 25%). In sector 1 they now have a health reduction of 20%, and 10% in sector 2.
- Campaign Reconnexus: If the Elementless Shop Emporium is available but hasn't yet been visited then there's now a tip text saying that Emporiums can be revisited.
- Campaign Reconnexus: If you have 2 Power Cores left and there's an Encrypted Stranger on the map who sells a Power Core then there's now a tip text to tell you.
- Rogue Convergence - Vulium Sector: During the swarm Observums will now spawn instead of Bobooms (so the element feels more distinct).
- Rogue/Campaign Survival: The base weapon damage reduction is now increased based on the Difficulty.
- Special Room - Haul Transmitter: When hacked it will now show a line of text (so you know exactly what it does).

//bug fixes
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 7: The End Boss map icon could sometimes not spawn.
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 5/6: You could sometimes be
- Campaign Reconnexus: Shops could sell you a passive item you already have.
- Vampire Survivor class: When offered the Voids Vigil weapon the usual passive item couldn't be given.
- Dronengineer shop: There was a chance of him offering an Element Drone whose Element doesn't appear in that Difficulty.
- Mega Fortify weapon trait: It was giving +1 stat per second (instead of +3).

notes.title: Patch v11.3
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Campaign Reconnexus - Difficulty 1 End Boss: Its Health has been reduced by 10% and the amount of times it attacks per salvo has been reduced to 11-13 (from 14-16).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: The Trade Emporium icon now has a more ornate border and uses more of its Element colour after being visited (so are easier to see in bigger maps and is more evident you can return to them).
- Campaign Reconnexus - Map: The Sanctum Conservators no longer need Power Cores to enter (the starting Cores have been reduced to offset this so it works out the same - this is mainly just to reduce chance of softlocking by forgetting about them).

- Rogue Survival: The weapon damage reduction after the second Swarm sector has been increased (mainly just affects long runs from Rogue/Campaign Survival).
- HUD: If you have more than 244 Max Health/Energy then it now uses a percentage calculation to determine the visual bar length (previously the bar would just cap out at 244 so you couldn't see how much you were being hurt if your Health/Energy was above that).
- Drone Alpha visibility setting: If the Alpha setting is lowered then the alpha of Medical/Guardum drones and their auras now remain a bit higher than other drones (since they are important to see).

//bug fixes
- Settings - Controls - Control Wizard: Opening this outside of the Title Screen when using a mouse wouldn't allow you to select the options.
- Compendium - Achievements: The Resplendent Envoy achievement text was too long.
- Compendium - Achievements: The Campaign Reconnexus achievement icons were misaligned.
- Campaign Reconnexus game mode - Map screen: When using a gamepad an extra map icon could sometimes remain selected.
- Scav Junker shop: When using a gamepad if the bottom item was a Drone then it would allow you to sell your own Drones.
- Salvage Stripper class: Salvaging a Mega Ability would transform it into a passive item.
- Abilitum Swarmous passive item: If you had any Mega Abilities then triggering this item would cause a crash.
- Bulleton Shield ability: The alpha of its aura was being affected by the Drone Alpha visibility setting.
- Guardum drone: Its aura had a low alpha.

notes.title: Patch v11.2
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Performance has been improved if there's a lot of enemies being killed (eg near the end of Survival Function).
- Star Devourer weapon: Cogs and Hacking texts now show above the weapon's projectiles.
- Abilitum Drone: They can no longer have the Droneous Doppelganger ability (can get too crazy).

//bug fixes
- Voidworld Challenges: When playing a Campaign mode restarting the run could create a different map.
- Campaign game mode - Map: The Fortify Trait stat bonus wasn't resetting until you entered the next sector.
- Campaign game mode - Map: When going into different Trade Emporiums some shop prices could carry over.
- Compendium - Achievements: The last page's achievements was overflowing the menu.
- Elementalists shop: When offered an Element Chamber the stat boost example wasn't showing for Elementful weapons.
- Cursed Shard ability: Its aura outline was too bright.
- Mega Alchemy trait: Its description was too long.

notes.title: Patch v11.1
notes.content:
//bug fixes
- Mimic Mouldmaker class: Opening the Choose Mimic Trait menu would cause a crash.
- Salvage Stripper class: He could use his salvage ability on a Voids Vigil weapon.
- Compendium - Leaderboards: There wasn't an option to view Campaign Reconnexus leaderboards.

notes.title: Voids Vigil Full Release
notes.content:
Welcome back Voidseekers new and old.. the Void gapes to reveal its true splendour to you. Voids Vigil is now fully released and fully playable. The game has also had a stonking update (v11), with the changes listed below, so even olden seekers will see new sights to witness.

Enjoy!  :]


The Campaign Reconnexus game mode has now been fully implemented. It includes all 7 Difficulties, Nightmare Mode, Campaign Survival, and now makes an appearance in Voidworld Trials too.

There's 3 new classes, the Dark Metaman, Pussy Purrer, and Salvage Stripper.

A new ultimate weapon called the Voids Vigil that has the power to erase enemies from time and space, and even bosses when its trait is upgraded.

7 new drone related Hats have been added and 2 new skin Colours (Pristine Sheen, Cursed Gloss). You can also now choose a Randomise option for the your Hat and/or Skin which randomises it each time you start a new run.

Some other Campaign Reconnexus game mode stuff...
- Map: Icons can now often not be connected to all its surrounding icons (to create more separate routes across the map).
- Map: A new special Sector has been added called Dormant Arena which uses the Survival Function level generation and has +50% enemy spawns.
- Map: A new Stranger event has been added called Core Seller who sells a Power Core for a nice price.
- Map: A new Stranger event has been added called X Marks The Spot who can reveal a hidden Treasure Hideaway Sector.
- Map: Various tweaks to the map generation.
- Map: The intro text has been replaced with a bottom text line, which is also used to show when you're low on Cores.
- Hats/Drones/Class unlock rooms can now also show in this game mode.
- End Boss - Difficulty 1: It now has 6 less Mini Eyes to poke out.
- End Boss - Difficulty 3: He will attack you with his Massive Balls less frequently now.

Some Clashful Cards game mode stuff...
- A 2 Player Mode has been added so 2 local players can give each other a jolly good bashing.
- When choosing where to deploy a Card it now shows which table spots it can attack.
- 9 new Cards have been added for the Blobbernought, Observum, and Ethereal Shade enemies.
- End Screen: Going to the Title Screen will now also open the Choose Game Mode menu.

Some Rogue Convergence game mode stuff...
- Nightmare Mode: During the Boss fight the usual Skullions will now also spawn.
- Nightmare Mode: Once the Swarm is triggered the spawn rate for Skullions is doubled.
- End Boss: The room will no longer spawn starting mines in regular mode, but will now always spawn them in Nightmare Mode.
- End Boss - Difficulty 2: It now has an extra Wall Laser and both Wall Lasers can now fire from the start (instead of only triggering when the boss is at 50% Health).
- Bosses now have a 20% reduction to Damage they suffer (so high Damage weapons do less).

Some Survival Function game mode stuff...

notes.title: Machina Monday #10
notes.content:
Welcome back Voidseekers to another Machina update!

In the Compendium an Achievements menu has been added so you can now keep track of all the achievements you do and don't have whilst ingame.

In the settings you can now choose to delete save data: either all unlocks, all settings, or all achievements.

Each of the Starting Weapons can now be upgraded up to level 3. To do this you just need to win a run whilst carrying that weapon which upgrades it by +1. The Gun Runner shop will now also mention if you have a particular offered weapon not unlocked as a starting weapon or fully upgraded. There's also a new achievement for fully upgrading a starting weapon.

The Schematic Engraver shop can now offer Mega Traits. Each weapon can upgrade their starting trait to a Mega Trait which greatly boosts its effect so each weapon feels a bit more unique. There's also an achievement for getting hold of a Mega Trait.

In the starting shops a new Class Heritage envoy will show where you can choose a free item. These offered items are specific to each class so the different classes can be tailored a bit (though the top offered item is random to spice things up). In the Survival Function the Envoy Trove will appear at the end of the first sector. There's also an achievement for approaching an Envoy with all offered items unlocked.

In Rogue Convergence during the shopping phase the background colour now changes to reflect the Sector's Element colour, which also affects what special event will show. For example the Scav Junker shop will now always appear in Emeralt sectors and won't appear in any other Elements, so you get different shopping experiences as you travel through the elements. In Argon sectors a new shop has been added called the Master Baiter who specialises in the various enemy luring Abilities. In Zenon sectors a new shop called the Bionica Ripperdoc will show who can boost your Body stats at the expense of Element stats.

A bigger version of the Blobby has been added called the Bigly Blobby which are used in Blob Containment sector interactables and the Blob Breeder Pools special sector. A bigger version of the Nightmare Mode's Skullion has also been added called the Voidmare Skullion who can show up in later sectors.

The Elementless and Elementful weaponry has been expanded. There's 2 new normal Elementful weapons, the Blobe Globe which can turn enemies into Blobbies, and the Alchemiser Staff which can turn Cogs into Gold Cogs. There's a new Elementful Mega Weapon called the Astro Starstorm which Trait allows you to manually change a weapon's Element Affinity. A new Elementless weapon has been added called the Quirksome Compiler which Trait gives weapons a bunch of random Traits. And there's now also Exhaust/Dynamo items for both the Elementful and Elementless weapons in case you want to specialise in either of them.

Some Campaign Reconnexus game mode stuff...
- Map Screen: There's now Radar Navigator sectors that need to be beaten to reveal more of the map (the first sector is now a Radar so the first Shop is easily found).
- Map Screen - Shops: The special shop events will now show up (eg Scav Junker shop).
- Map Screen: The background colour now changes to reflect the Difficulty Element colour (and changes when visiting shops).
- Map Screen - Difficulty 3: The screen now scrolls (so the bottom text doesn't completely cover map icons).

Some other Rogue Convergence game mode stuff...
- If the Sector Exit Portal is open then any Cog pickups being sucked to you will now be sucked faster.
- Gun Runner shop: There's now a chance of weapons coming with free upgrades based on the sector (so it's easier to swap weapons late on).
- Schematic Engraver shop: The amount of Blueprints that will be offered per visit is now random and capped to 3 (so you'll always be offered regular items).
- Abilitum Installer shop: The amount of Enemy Lure abilities that can be offered per visit is now capped to 1-2 (in case they aren't your thing).
- Scav Junker shop: After each item name it now says the type of item it is.

Other miscellaneous changes...
- Fullscreen: The game no longer uses exclusive fullscreen (which helps with compatibility especially when tabbing in/out or dealing with screensavers).
- The Menu Console that appears at the bottom that shows info (eg item text) now has a transparent background (so you can still see stuff behind it).
- Elite/Mega enemies now have less chance of spawning in sectors 1-2.
- Beacon Transmitter sector interactable: This now has a chance of being a Crate variant which spawns Cog Crates (instead of Spawn Beacons).
- Gravitonne Gun weapon: Its projectiles are now slightly transparent (so stuff can be seen below them).
- Spook weapon trait: This will now spawn the Shade at the same position as the dead enemy. Shade enemies are now immune from this trait.
- Chronos Relapse ability: Its Cool Down has been reduced to 50 seconds (from 69). Its cost has been reduced to 30 (from 40).

- Runner Supplies passive item: When upgrading Gun Runner weapons it no longer increases their cost.
- Scav Junker shop: The chance for it to offer non-passive items has been increased.
- Whirling Ball hazard: They now start closer to their base position (as you could enter the sector touching it).

And bug fixes...
- Campaign Reconnexus - End Boss: Killing the Boss while enemies were spawning could cause a crash.

notes.title: Machina Monday #9
notes.content:
Welcome back Voidseekers to another Machina update!

3 new challenge Classes have been added, along with their usual achievements.
- Enfeebled Watcher: Good at blasting loads and sucking cogs but his weapons don't work if he's moving.
- Tofu Chaser: Provides score related boosts mostly by getting hurt as little as possible.
- Eggcellent Eggy: Good luck sorting out your loadout with this chap.

A new common enemy has been added called the Observum. They have the usual 2 upgraded forms and will show up in Vulium sectors onwards. They're slow moving but will teleport in around you.

A new elite enemy has been added called the Balliston Belcher who pops up at the bottom of the screen to blast out some drooping projectiles and can be found in Vulium sectors.

A new oddity enemy has been added called the Voidmare Skullion who will only show in Nightmare Mode. They just bounce around the screen and are more intended to soak up your projectiles.

A new hazard has been added which is a big spiked whirling ball. It can very rarely show in normal mode but has mainly been added to add some spice to Nightmare Mode and Pandorum Difficulty.

In Rogue Convergence when browsing the Shops the icons for the Encrypted Stranger and Corrupted Shop Signal are now colour coded (so are easier to see at a glance and make use of the Element system). Vulium sectors now have a high chance of a Corrupted Shop Signal, and Zenon sectors now always have an Encrypted Stranger. 

There's also a new special shop called the Scav Junker who can sell items from any shop, except weapons, and will always have a nice Sale on (he mostly shows up in Emeralt sectors). There's also a new shop event called the Transmission Router who can route you to a shop of your choosing for a small fee (it mostly shows up in Serenos sectors). The Gun Runner shop can now offer weapons that have an Elementful Affinity (which always uses your highest Element stat).

6 new weapons have been added: Butchery Blade, Anointed Trident, Gauss Acceletron, Shieldron Rotatron, Smog Smoker, Proton Alchemiser.
Along with their new traits: Smite, Curse, Fortify, Shield, Choke, Chemistry.

Some Campaign Reconnexus game mode stuff...
- End Boss: It's bottom gate will now open and spawn enemies when it reaches certain health percentages (the enemy type is based on the Difficulty).
- Difficulty 2 - End Boss: One of the eyes now fires a huge laser instead of multiple smaller lasers (to better reflect the Rogue Convergence boss).

Some other Rogue Convergence game mode stuff...
- End Boss: They now have a slightly boosted starting Health based on how many Mega Weapons you have.
- Difficulty 7 - End Boss: His attack type is now randomised after each attack. It now has its own Bestiary entry (Conservator Custodian Mk7).
- 2 new sector special rooms: Beacon Transmitter, Haul Transmitter
- Elite Enemies: Each Element sector now mainly spawns a particular elite enemy type (so the different Element sectors are more distinct), though there's always a chance for a Gyronoious (to make use of their upgraded forms).

Some new Voidworld Trials traits...
- Hauler Convoy: Greatly boosts the amount of Booty Haulers that arrive.
- Cursed Accursed: Enemies have an extra 69% chance of spawning Cursed.
- Hurt Me More: All Damage you and enemies suffer is boosted by 1-69%

Other new stuff...
- 7 new Abilities: Lure Observum, Lure Balliston, Bodily Bolster, Shockwave Ripple, Data Overload, Droneous Doppelganger, Ablitum Mirror
- 3 new Passive items: Abilitious Heirloom, Cog Craver Contact, Shocker Phreaker

Other miscellaneous changes...
- Survival Function: After the first Swarm sector enemies now have an increasing chance of being immune from the Flee status effect.
- Argon/Emeralt Convergence Challenge achievements: These two have swapped conditions (eg the Not Getting Hurt challenge is now done on Difficulty 1).
- Blank Cartridge passive item: This is now automatically triggered when hit by an enemy projectile (instead of only having a 25% chance) but needs to recharge for 30 seconds after use. An icon follows you when active.
- Cog Protection passive item: Its cost has increased to 69 (from 44).
- Droneous Eggling ability: The Level of the Drone is now always the same as the Level of the Ability (instead of being random).
- Missile Salvo ability: The explosion size of its missiles has been increased.
- Bodily Mists ability: It now boosts Body stats by 11-33 (instead of 11-22).
- Mega Ability / Abilitum Drones: Their initial Cool Down is now halved until they trigger their Abilities.
- Booty Hauler: There's now a rare chance of it being a gold variant which when hacked boosts your Body stats. They now move a bit slower in earlier Difficulties and Sector 0. They now have a brighter animation effect (so are easier to notice in the chaos).
- Data Hauler / Data Dump / Datarium Bank: When Hacked they now give extra Score based on the current Sector.

And bug fixes...
- Rogue Survival - Difficulty 7: The Swarm wasn't being triggered.
- Choose Weapon: The weapon's Precision stat was using its Damage stat.
- Shops: If all shops had a Corrupted Signal then it could cause a softlock.
- Shops - Encrypted Stranger - Trojan Signal: His steal could take you into negative Cogs.
- Monster Hunter class: Its trait description was wrong.
- Recycler Automaton class: He could be offered a Mega Potion (which was pointless).
- Droneous Eggling ability: It could hatch an Element Servo that shouldn't be in that Difficulty. It could hatch into an Eggy Weggy bypassing its usual Duration.
- Beacon Beckoner passive item: This couldn't spawn Giga Spawn Beacons.
- Crate Beckoner passive item: This couldn't spawn Giga Cog Crates.
- Rogue Convergence - Difficulty 7 End Boss: Dying to this Boss would say you were killed by Twists of Fate.
- Lazumi Missileer enemy: In a Darkness sector its laser wasn't showing in front of the darkness.


Enjoy!  :]

notes.title: Machina Monday #8
notes.content:
Welcome back Voidseekers to another Machina update!

A new Difficulty option has been added called Nightmare Mode which is unlocked when you've beaten all Difficulties. You can choose to play this mode through any Difficulty with it ramping everything up, more enemies, more pain, more tomfoolery. On the plus side you get to choose 2 weapons to start with instead of the usual 1 and have some starting Body stat boosts. They have their own leaderboards to beat off your chums with and 2 Achievements have been added, one for winning each of the two game modes which can be done on any Difficulty. It's still a bit experimental atm and can get very wild at higher Difficulties so best of luck nightmare runners!

A new elite enemy has been added called the Missileer Lazumi who flies in pairs firing a laser between them. There's the usual Lure Ability for him too.

During each sector you will now see wandering Booty Haulers who float on past. They are harmless and can be hacked giving you either a boost in Score or Cogs.

During each sector a Data Dump interactable may also spawn (the chance being based on the sector) which gifts a Score boost when hacked.

The Cog Crates and Spawn Beacons now have a chance of being Giga versions with the chance being based on the Difficulty. In the case of the Cog Crate it doubles its Cog value, or for the Spawn Beacon it boosts the amount of enemies it lures by +50%.

A new Elementless weapon has been added called the Skullion Sceptre whose Spook Traitum can spawn Ethereal Shades when killing enemies.

7 new Challenge Achievements have been added which are for completing a Rogue Convergence run doing a particularly impressive feat. Each Difficulty has its own challenge, such as winning a run without getting hurt, reaching a nice high score, or within a fast time.

A new Visibility setting has been added called Player Attack Alpha which adjust the opacity of your weapon's attacks and can even make them completely invisible.

Some Campaign Reconnexus game mode stuff...
- You can now play through the first 3 Difficulties.
- Special class traits should all work now (eg the Vampire's Techarcana Card selection now shows each time you beat a sector).
- Sectors will now almost always have a special event and can include the Stranger special sector events (eg Treasure Hideaway).

Some Rogue Convergence game mode stuff...
- There's a chance a Shop may now have a Corrupted Signal in which case you won't know its type and you can only enter once.
- A new special room has been added called the Datarium Bank which gives Score when hacked.
- In the first sector the guaranteed Essence Vat is now replaced depending on the Difficulty (eg in Difficulty 4 there's now a Cursed Monument instead).
- The type of sector Element now affects the type of special rooms it has (eg Vulium sectors have an increased chance of a Cursed Monument).
- When spawning an Elite Enemy there's now a 50% chance of it spawning a particular Enemy depending on the sector Element (eg Emeralt has an increased chance for Plump Nukems).
- Essence Vat room: There's now a chance of it having a blue variant (which boosts either Recovery, Defence, or Speed) and a 15% chance for a Gold variant (which boosts all Body stats).
- Elementalist Shop: It now has an extra chance of offering a Stone, Gem, or Jewel item based on your Weapons.
- Win Screen: An extra text line has been added. The texts are now revealed line by line per Difficulty (instead of word by word).
- Sector Exit Portal: There's now a small delay before the portal can begin to suck you.

Some misc changes to the Survival Function game mode...
- After the second Swarm sector enemies now start getting a bit faster with each extra sector.
- Magical Trove: Its Options text now shows faster (was annoying having to wait for them to show).

Other new stuff...
- Added an Achievement called "Died To Weakest Enemy" for dying to a Scooties Mk1 (how embarrassing!)
- 4 new Passive Items: Beacon Gigatonia, Crate Gigatonia, Data Beckoner, Force Field.
- 2 new Abilities: Lure Lazumi, Haul Deliveroo.

Other misc changes...
- Hackable Interacters that have an active effect now say what they're doing when you enter their Hacking Circle (eg Spawn Beacons now say "currently: spawning enemies").
- There's been many tweaks to various weapon Damage and Fire Rate so they are more inline with comparable weapons (eg the Void Devourer was rather underpowered).
- Melee weapons now have a Damage reduction if they do a lot of Damage (this only really has an affect if there's A LOT of enemies).
- The amount of debris that enemies create when killed has been reduced (to improve visibility and performance).
- Status Screen: The Config tab now shows the full Settings menu (instead of just the Visibility menu).
- Settings - Visibility - Drone Alpha: This is now set to 90% by default.
- Depreciated Wretch class - Wretched Stealings: The stolen items no longer need its price to be less than your Speed stat.
- Monster Hunter class - Upgraded Hunter: The chance to fully upgrade enemies has increased to 11% (from 6%).
- Mega Drones: When offered a Mega Drone the second required Drone to scrap no longer needs to be at level 3 (instead it can be any level).
- Circlet Amplifier weapon: This now has Elementless Affinity (seemed a bit odd having a single Elementful weapon).
- Void Devourer weapon: Its projectiles are now slightly transparent (so you can see Cogs and interactables behind it).
- Knockback weapon trait: This now knocks enemies away by a set amount (instead of being based on Damage), but enemies now can only get knocked-back once.
- Hex weaopn trait: The chance to inflict Hex has been reduced to 33% (from 50%).
- Ghosts In The Machine ability: The Ghosts now fade out when near the center of the screen (to improve visibility).
- Sector Systematiser enemy: They now won't attack you unless you attack it.
- Ethereal Watcher enemy: The charge up for his laser attack is now slower (was rather difficult to react to).
- Gyronoious enemy: Their balls will no longer destroy your attacks and upon death no longer spawn bullets (to reduce bullet spam).
- Sentri enemy: They now fire one less bullet per spawn (to reduce bullet spam).
- Blossum enemy: The amount of bullets they spawn when they die has been reduced (to reduce bullet spam).
- Torpedo Glider enemy: Their bullets now destroy themselves more quickly (to reduce bullet spam).

Changes to Passive items to make them more useful...
- The cost of many items has been reduced (notably the higher priced items).
- Abilitum Resync: Its Ability Cool Rate bonus has been increased to 0-25 (from 0-20).
- Tome of True Diagrams: The bonus Damage now also applies to Elite enemies. It can now be offered in the Survival Function game mode.
- Cog Magnet: Its bonus suck range has been increased to 44% (from 33%).
- Hex Chipset: Its chance to inflict Hex has increased to 1-33% (instead of 11%).
- Stolen Artifact: Its enemy upgrade chance has been increased to 15% (from 11%).
- Five Finger Function: The stolen item no longer needs its price to be less than your Speed stat. Its cost has increased to 66 (from 50).
- Aromatic Fungus: Its -5 Max Energy penalty is now a +5 Max Energy boost.
- Mega Potion: When used this now gives full Health (instead of +69) and 6 seconds of Invincibility (instead of 3).
- Smithy Anvil: This now has a chance of upgrading an Ability or Drone (instead of only upgrading Weapons).
- Runner Supplies: The Shop weapon now has a chance of being offered at Level 3 (instead of only Level 2).
- Inflamous Sphere: This no longer reduces your Max Health.
- Curse Chipset: Its chance to inflict Curse has increased to 1-33% (instead of 11%).

And bug fixes...
- Tutorial: Fixed a typo (excercise).
- Compendium - Leaderboard: When viewing scores in a Daily/Weekly Convergence Trial the Rogue Survival tip was showing.
- When choosing a Class/Difficulty/Weapon hovering over Fortuity Destiny wasn't showing the Confirm button tip.
- Mimic Mouldmaker / Psycho Possessed classes: They could be offered passive items at the shop which could cause issues when later taking Class related items.
- Psycho Possessed class: If possessing an Ethereal Eternal you could get trapped 
- Encrypted Stranger - Classious Heirloom: You could be offered a Class item that could cause an issue with later offered passive items.
- Automised Upgrader sector room: If you were currently Dashing when it upgraded a weapon then it would remove your weapons.
- Mega Drones: Their Servomegatronica name was too long for the shop panel (they've been renamed to Servomegatron).
- Element Mist abilities: You could be offered/given these even if the Element doesn't appear in that Difficulty.
- Most of the Vulium weapons were using the same basic Auto-slugger weapon sprite.
- Cogger Convoker weapon: Its stats weren't being boosted by its Level.
- Rangum Converge weapon: Its muzzle flash was the wrong colour.
- Derelict Runner item: It wouldn't create the Treasure Chest room if it was a special sector.
- Specialous Sectorium item: It wouldn't create the extra room if it was a special sector.
- Enormous Eyeball item: Its description was missing the More Enemies tip.
- Sector Systematiser enemy: If not killed it would remain even after the sector had ended.

- Gyronoious enemy: Dying to its balls would count as "Twists of Fate" on the Game Over screen.


Enjoy!  :]

notes.title: Machina Monday #7
notes.content:
Welcome back Voidseekers. Do hope the holiday hangover effects are long gone for here is another belated Machina update present to unwrap!

A new class has been added, who filthy Boneraisers may recognise, called the Psycho Possessed. Each sector he becomes temporarily possessed by a class sharing all their traits, so is a more reliable but random take on the Mimic. There's the usual 3 achievements to get.

A mega version of the Ethereal Shade has been added which will show in the Unelemental Temple. The Temple can also now have a new hazard that spawns Shades nearby.

A new elite enemy has been added called the Torpedo Glider who drops long lasting unmoving bullets behind it to get in your way. They have a chance of spawning instead of the usual Gyron/Nukem to add a bit of variety.

A new Visibility setting has been added called Glitch Effects which turns off the black static screen glitch effect (eg when opening the Status Screen).

The Elementalist shop has 3 new item types to offer...
- Dynamo: Gives a bonus depending on the Element and is boosted the more Element weapons of that type you have (eg Argon Dynamo boosts enemy upgrade chance).
- Exhaust: Boosts a particular Body stat depending on the Element and is boosted the more Element weapons of that type you have.
- Leech: Boosts a particular Element stat each sector but reduces your Max Health.

2 new weapons along with their new traits...
- Cogger Convoker: An Elementless gun that dishes out Cogs each sector based on the weapon's Level.
- Circlet Amplifier: A new Elementful gun which Affinity auto-uses your highest Element stat and trait boosts its stats with each sector.

2 new hackable sector devices...
- Automated Upgrader: Upgrades a random weapon, ability, or drone for free.
- Cursed Monument: Enemies have a 16% of spawning Cursed.

3 new Drones...
- Occultist: Who can Curse enemies and boost the Curse's effect.
- Eggy Weggy: A cheap drone who each sector mimics a random drone.
- Element (5 types): Offers several different boosts depending on the Element.

Other new stuff...
- 3 new Abilities: Lure Glider, Bodily Bolster, Element Mist (x6)
- 1 new Passive Item: Sullen Urn
- 1 new Hat: Elemental
- 1 new Skin Colour: GOOOLD Plated

Some Rogue Convergence game mode stuff...
- The end timer for sectors has been increased by +1 second per sector (starting at sector 2 and capped to +6).
- Elite enemies can no longer spawn during the Swarm.
- Difficulty 6 Boss: The Shade enemies that spawn when destroying a Boss Eye now won't spawn if it was the final Eye.

Other misc changes...
- Improved performance if there's a lot of enemies.
- HUD: The timer will now show as a red skull and red text once the Swarm has been triggered.
- The Last Gasp health mechanic (where you're reduced to 1 Health instead of killed) now has a 20 second cool down.

Welcome back Voidseekers to another Machina update!

2 new classes have been added along with their usual achievements...
- Traiton Tinkerer: Who has extra access to Traitum items and weapon element affinities.
- Accurse Wracked: Who has to contend with cursed meanies.

A Bestiary has been added to the Codex Compendium which has a gallery of all the enemies as well as their stats and how many you've killed. 3 new achievements have been added for filling it out.

The Bestiary is also used for some added meta progression where the Abilities that lure enemies must now be unlocked by killing a certain amount of those enemies. 8 new lure Abilities have been added to fill in the remaining enemies.

A new enemy has been added called the Blobbernought who comes with the usual 3 upgraded forms, and upon destruction can pop out Blobbies so be careful not to get overwhelmed by numbers. They can show up in the latter Difficulty themes and are mainly so the different themes are more distinct from each other (for example in the Blue theme this new enemy replaces the Bobooms completely).

The third upgraded form for the Ethereal Shade enemy has been added which you'll meet in the very late Difficulties.

A new elite enemy has been added called the Plump Nukem which can spawn instead of the usual Gyron and has a bigly explosion when destroyed so you best keep a distance as they can also spawn in packs.

There's now a Last Gasp health mechanic where if you have at least 40 Health and get hit by an enemy attack that would normally kill you then it will now reduce you to 1 Health instead.

Some new Rogue Convergence game mode stuff...
- There's now a small chance of the sector being extra dark which reduces your vision (the chance is based on the Difficulty).
- A new hackable room has been added called Blob Containment which releases a bunch of Blobbies to boost your score.

Some new Visibility settings...

Other new stuff...
- 2 new Voidworld Challenges Trial Traits: Always Dark, Blob Spawns
- 3 new Passive items: Store Restockments, Curse Antenna, Derelict Runner
- 1 new Ability: Cursed Shard
- 1 new hat: Blobby

Some misc changes to the Rogue Convergence game mode...

- There's now a small chance of the sector event being one of the special Stranger events (eg Systematiser Sector).
- Normal sectors can now have multiples of the same hackable room (previously they could only have 1 of each type).
- The sector end portal will no longer push you away when it's opening.

- Traitum Trove: Blueprinted items are now free.

- There's now an increasing chance for a Mega Enemy to show based on the swarm sector number.

Other misc changes...
- You now flash red when at very low Health.
- The Ability blobs above you (that signify when an Ability is ready) are now a bit bigger and play a small shockwave animation when they become ready.
- Settings - Visibility - Drone Alpha: It now also shows the Guard drone aura as an example.

notes.title: Machina Monday #5
notes.content:
Welcome back Voidseekers to another Machina update!

3 new classes have been added along with the usual achievements...
- Monster Hunter: Who hunts for mega bots.
- Bunker Buster: For boomy good times.
- Orbilas Kindle: Whose protected by orbitals.

Mega upgraded versions of the Driluim, Boboom, and Sentrion enemies have been added. Mega enemies can now also spawn in any element sector, the chance being based on the run Difficulty.

A new elite enemy has been added called a Gyron who swings around balls of pain that also block your bullets. Unlike regular enemies they can periodically spawn in addition to the usual spawns depending on the Difficulty.

Some changes to the Campaign Reconnexus game mode...
- The Shops now work more like in Rogue Convergence so it will keep track of the empty item slots when you buy an item and only re-fill them when you buy a Re-Roll.
- The level scaling (eg enemy health/upgrades/damage) now take into account the level Element so for example Emeralt levels now have a higher base difficulty than Argon (previously it was just based on how many levels you beat).
- The level's Special can now have the usual Rogue Convergence sector events (eg Manufactorium Zone).

In Rogue Convergence 2 new sector special rooms have been added...
- Beacon: This has 2 variants which can be hacked to lure either a Mega Enemy or a Mine Barge. 
- Treasure Chest: Offers a free Passive Item to choose from.

In Survival Function there's now a chance of a Magical Trove spawning instead of a normal Treasure Trove, which when opened allows you to choose which type of shop items it will offer.

Also...
4 new Weapons: Busted Radiatron, Spring Harpoon, Gravitonne Gun, Ceremonial Mace
4 new Weapon Traits: Emission, Snag, Demi, Augment
5 new Passive Items: Exotic Plates, Enormous Eyeball, Inflamous Sphere, Pressurised Pump, Carbonised Steel
4 new Abilities: Ghosts In The Machine, All Eyes, Fortuity Abilitous, Chronos Relapse
1 new Hat: Gyron

Some misc changes...
- Game Over screen: It will now say which enemy killed you.
- Rogue Convergence: The end boss Survival Beacon will now spawn if you have beaten the Difficulties with any class (previously you had to beat them with the current class).
- Survival Function: The Traitum Trove now spawns more consistently.
- Survival Function: Special and Class related Treasure Troves will now say their special name when you're hacking it.
- Survival Function: In Pandorum Difficulty the chance of a random Trove type has been increased.

notes.title: Patch v4.1
Machina Monday #4
notes.content:
Welcome back Voidseekers to another Machina update!

The sneak peak into the Campaign Pilgrimage game mode is now playable. It took quite a while longer than I thought to get the game mode up and running so you can only play around in the Emeralt Difficulty for now but it gives a nice idea of the gameplay (though still a bit scuffed and unfinished in some places). There's online leaderboards for the game mode but no achievements just yet.

A new class has been added called the Vampire Survivor who deals in mysterious Techarcana Cards that make use of the Voidworld Challenge trial traits. There's the usual class related achievements for him.

In a Rogue Convergence after you've beaten the end boss, if you've already beaten that Difficulty as well as that Survival Function's Difficulty then a mysterious beacon will now spawn. You can Hack into it to continue your run for a bit longer where you'll be taken to a Rogue Survival arena. There's extra leaderboards for these special Survival arenas too to fight over as well as an achievement.

Gun Runner shops now have a small chance of offering a weapon from any Element pool, though they will still use an Element appropriate for that Difficulty. So for example in Difficulty 1 you can now be offered a Rocket Launcher that uses the Argon Element (usually Rocket Launchers are reserved for Difficulty [5]+ runs). In the Pandorum Difficulty all weapons have their Element links randomised so you never know what you'll be offered.

2 new achievements called 'Rogue Destiny' and 'Survival Destiny' have been added which you can get by beating those game modes using Fortuity Destiny to select your Class, Difficulty, and Starting Weapon. 3 other new achievements have also been added, one each for getting a Mega Weapon/Ability/Drone.

- On the Win / Game over screen there's now a shortcut button to show the online leaderboard.

- Status Screen: If you have a lot of passive items then you can now page through them all (previously it would only ever show the first 48 items).
- HUD: The size of the background of the Health/Energy bars is now based on your Max Health/Energy (so you can see how close you currently are to max).
- Shopping Phase: The chance for an Encrypted Stranger to show has been increased, and greatly increased in Pandorum Difficulty.

- Fortuity Destiny: When restarting a new run the Fortuity Destiny for Difficulty and Starting Weapon wasn't randomising.

The Ethereal Shade enemies now have an upgraded form which show themselves in the late levels. The Mineire enemy now also has a mega version which will show in Vulium Effluvium sectors.

A new sector special room has been added called the Sector Systematiser which is a mega enemy you can choose to fight for nice fat Cogs and Score or leave well alone (wuss?)

2 new Passive Items: Runner Supplies, Loot Box.

notes.title: Machina Monday #2
notes.content:
Welcome Voidseekers to the first Machina Monday (which is unhelpfully called #2 just to conform with the game's version).

Firstly just a big thanks to YOU for the reception of this silly robotical game. It's now eligible for Trading Cards which I've submitted for the big man Gaben to approve (it says it takes a few days). I'll make a news post when they're available for collecting.

But for now... Machina Monday updates will arrive every other week adding extra content and stuff to do, such as new classes, weapons, achievements, etc. As well as a bunch of other bits and bobs, like balance tweaks, QoL, bug fixes, etc. There's still quite a lot of those bits and bobs to finish off so in between there will be Maintenance Monday patches to try and slog through that hefty to-do list. And there may be hot fix patches whenever needed if crashes or other major issues pop up.

6 new classes to unlock have been added along with their usual achievements...
- Debug Dummy: A nice all-rounder who gains boosts for hacking.
- Amongoussy Allurer: A challenge class who deals with lots of meanies.
- Dodgy Networker: A class to explore the Stranger contacts.
- Errant Knight: For melee mashing fun.
- Banished Prisoner: Who adds some shopping spree interest.
- Talent Mimic: The strangest vessel who mimics the talents of other classes.

5 new weapons have been added (including the first Elementless weapon): Scrap Lobber, Master Sword, Reaping Sickle, Molecular Magnetron, Manifold Wand.

And 5 new Traitum items to go along with the weapons: Shellshock, Pristine, Discharge, Cook, Prism.

7 New Passive Items: Sealmentus Staff, Data Sync, Static Field, Knightly Shield, Bodily Chipset, Energy Fusion, Hydraulicised Emerald.

3 new Encrypted Stranger events: Desiccated Vessel, Ethereal Extortion, Coupon Cracker.

3 new Hats!: Boboom, Driluim, Scoots.

A new CRT style resolution has been added (1280x960). Both this and the Steam Deck's 1280x800 resolution now use correct scaling (instead of just stretching the screen). So during gameplay you'll have some extra room at the top and bottom to play with, though when showing any of the menus they still use the native 720p height (but show a texture at the top/bottom to hide the black bars).

Some improvements to menus when using a gamepad or keyboard-only controls.
- Shop: When an empty item is selected it will now show the usual selector icon.
- Shop: Moving the selector will no longer loop (eg in a Weapon Shop pressing Left when a shop item is selected will no longer move it to the Precision stat).
- Weapon Shop: If your Gun Stats are being shown but you're selecting a shop item then gun stat icon selector is now grey.
- Choose Shop menu: Pressing Up when a shop door is currently selected now won't take you to Continue, while pressing Down when the Continue is currently selected now won't take you to the shop doors.

Other misc changes...
- A new 1600x900 resolution has been added.
- Tutorial: The Status Screen section now talks about the Config tab having visibility options.
- Choose Starting Weapon menu: When hovering over a weapon whose element isn't contained within the chosen Difficulty then it will now display a warning.
- Rogue Convergence - Difficulty [3] Boss: The speed of his big balls have been reduced.
- Hats: The Sentrion and Snekouss hats now animate.
- Blacksmith Forger class: Each sector he now also gets a free upgrade for a random weapon, ability, and drone.
- Cog Gobbler class: He no longer gets healing Cog Sniffer drones, instead collecting Cog pickups now heals you and all Max Health modifiers now count as Max Energy modifiers.
- Guild Merchant class: Up to 3 shops will now have a sale on (instead of 1). In Survival Function 1-3 extra Troves will spawn each sector (instead of 1).
- Stranger event - Transference Elementaliser: When hovering over the option it will now also show your Max Health/Energy.
- Added some extra messages when you Hack various objects and special rooms (so you have a better idea of what they do).
- Rangum Converge weapon: Its projectile speed has been reduced (so they have more time to home-in on enemies).
- Auto-slugger weapon: Slightly increased its attack cool down.
- Buck Blunderbuss weapon: Slightly reduced its attack cool down.
- Diablos Sword weapon: This has changed to an Axe.
- Master Crafted Weapons passive item: This has been removed (been replaced with the Pristine weapon trait).
- Syphon Traitum: Its cost has been increased by +20.
- Doom Traitum: Its cost has been reduced by -14.
- The cost of all mega weapons has been increased by +20.
- Droneous Eggling ability: The Drone it spawns can now be of level 1-3 (instead of 1).
- Loyalty Card item: The highest possible sale discount is now 50% (instead of 35%).
- Vitality Banks item: It's Max Health/Energy bonus is now +5 (instead of +10).
- Mega Potion item: This now also creates a shockwave when used.
- Home Traitum item: The homing effect now reduces over time (so slow projectiles don't hang around the middle of the screen).

And some bug fixes...
- Game Won/Over screen: There was a chance of it crashing when using the Fortuity Destiny class.
- Codex Compendium - Weapon Itemography: The weapon's Damage stat wasn't correct.
- Mega Abilities: They would sometimes switch to a non-ability item if you bought temporary items.
- Shop - Stranger - Distilled Bodiliser: The stat boost could be the same stat as the reduction. The stat reduction would instead boost it.


Enjoy! :]

notes.title: Patch v1.9
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Increased your basic movement speed by +5%.
- Element Bearer classes: If you're playing a Difficulty that doesn't include your default Element Core then you can now be offered an appropriate Core.
- Rogue Convergence - Difficulty 3 Boss: Reduced the size of the collision mask on the largest balls. Increased its attack cool down.
- Emeralt Sectors: Cog pickups are now coloured more blue (so they blend in less with enemies).
- Element Core items: Clarified in its description that the stat boost will change if the element stat later changes.
- Mega Potion item: This now also gives 3 seconds of Invincibility when used.
- Manufactorium special room: The amount of enemies it spawns has been increased.
- Mega Sneki enemy: It now turns around when offscreen faster.
- Void Devourer weapon: Their homing behaviour now works more like a regular homing projectile (so they don't hang around the middle of the screen).
- Bubble Brewer weapon: Reduced the brightness of its projectiles.
- Cog Hammer weapon: Increased its Damage.

//bug fixes
- It was possible to get multiple Hat unlocks in a single run.
- Bigly Auraments item: It wasn't boosting some auras.
- Five Finger Function item: You could steal some items you wouldn't be able to buy.

notes.title: Patch v1.8
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Improved base performance during sectors.
- Online Leaderboard: When opening a leaderboard if the filter was set to You but you don't have a score to show then it will now temporarily switch to showing the Elite scores.
- The Mouse Lock Cursor setting is now set to Off by default.
- Rogue Convergence: Clashful Card pickups now won't fly away when the exit portal opens.
- Corrosion status: This now inflicts 11-22 Damage per second (instead of 10).

//bug fixes
- Settings: Opening the Control Wizard from the Escape Menu wasn't showing it.
- Abilities were using the wrong level to determine their cool-down.
- Abilitary Connoisseur class: There was a chance the Abilitum shop wouldn't be offered if a Stranger event shows.
- Cog Gobbler class: You could be offered the Cogged Healthies and Health Chip passive items.
- Void Devourer weapon: It's projectiles weren't destroying themselves when leaving the view.

notes.title: Patch v1.7
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Rogue Convergence: On the win screen the Menu Confirm will now take you to the title screen while Menu Back will start a new run.
- Voidworld Trials: On the win/death screen going to the title will now immediately take you to Choose Trials menu.
- Increased the amount of Invincibility frames you get when hit.
- Reduced the amount of contact damage upgraded enemies do.
- The level 3 Bobombous enemy now won't create bullets when it's killed.
- Servo Gunineer drone: Its cost has been increased by +10.

//bug fixes
- Buying an upgrade for a weapon that was the same as was used to buy a mega weapon could cause a crash.
- A class's chosen Hat wasn't being worn if you went to the title screen and didn't open the Skins menu.
- Choosing a class Paint would then use that colour for all classes.
- The run timer stat wasn't increasing during the shopping phase.
- Enemy laser attacks could hit you before they had fully powered up.
- Abilitum Enscripter shop: The Ability Fortuity Shipment item was displaying a cool-down.
- Blacksmithy Forger class: The colour of guns he gives wasn't correct.
- Clashful Card unlock tip: The colour of the icon wasn't correct.
- Broken Chronotron passive item: Its description didn't have the "extra enemies" tip.

notes.title: Patch v1.6
notes.content:
//misc changes
- The room transition effect has been changed so it's less bright and glitchy.
- The black static effect when entering/exiting the Status Screen and Shops have been reduced.
- Reduced the brightness of enemy lasers, explosions and some Boss attacks.
- Rogue Convergence - The Cog value pickup soft cap has been increased to 333.
- Rogue Convergence - The Cog value pickup soft cap now only counts the amount of Cogs you've picked up that sector (instead of just using your current Cog amount).
- Rogue Convergence - Difficulty [5] Boss: If the huge eye begins to attack then the medium eyes will now stop attacking.
- Shop - Encrypted Contact: The cost of their services have been increased by +5.

//bug fixes
- When choosing a Difficulty or Starting Weapon you couldn't choose the Fortuity Destiny option.
- When choosing a Difficulty the Best Score stat was wrong (it was saving the data wrong so you'll need to set a new best score).
- Compendium: If you tried to access the Leaderboards during or just after playing the Tutorial then it would cause a crash.
- Clashful Cards: When using a gamepad if you only had one card left to choose and pressed Up/Down then it would cause a hard freeze.
- When opening the Status Screen there was a rare chance of it causing a crash.
- Gun Runner shop: If you were offered more than 1 mega weapon and had the same weapons then they could still be used for another mega weapon even if they weren't level 3.
- Dronengineer shop: There was a rare chance of a crash when buying an upgrade.
- Auxiliary Droneus passive item: If you have this item the Status Screen would not show the drone icons correctly.
- Jellied Lifeform passive item: This could still give score during a Boss fight.

notes.title: Patch v1.5
notes.content:
//misc changes
- When you select a Class it will now check to see if you have its unlock achievement and give it if you don't (in case Steam didn't the first time).
- You can now re-enter Shops that have sold out (in case you want to sell/move your items).
- Changed some of the Shop descriptions so it's clearer they allow you to sell/move your items.
- Syphon Traitium passive item: Its Max Health/Energy boost now has a soft cap of 333.

//bug fixes
- Device Repository shop: When using a gamepad pressing Left/Right when the bottom item is selected will cause a crash.
- Gun Runner shop: When using a gamepad selling/removing one of your weapons would always take the first weapon.
- Elementalist / Schematic Engraver shop: When using a gamepad you couldn't examine your weapon elements.
- Survival Function game mode: Taking the Auxiliary Abilitum item from a Trove could cause a crash.
- Survival Function game mode: When using a gamepad the Treasure Trove's Remove/Skip were assigned to the same button.
- Survival Function game mode: When using a gamepad if you take a Weapon Trove item then the selected panel sprite is wrong.
- Void Devourer weapon: This was doing very little damage if you had the Blast Traitum.
- BFG 6900 weapon: This was doing less damage if you had the Blast Traitum.
- Loyalty Card item: There would sometimes not be a shop on sale.

notes.content:

- Settings - General - Display: The Borderless Window option wasn't triggering when you booted up the game.
- Codex Compendium - Itemography: When using a gamepad the menus weren't working correctly.

- Element Deposit special room: In an Elementless Temple area hacking an Element Deposit wasn't giving anything (it now chooses a random element to boost).
- You could enter a new sector from the portal and be immediately killed by a very well placed Mineus enemy.

notes.content:
//bug fixes

- Voidworld Trials game mode: Entering a trial for the first time could cause a crash.
- Shopping Phase - Gun Runner shop: When using a gamepad if you had a lot of guns and moved the selector to your guns then back to the shop items it could cause a crash.

notes.content:

- Gunineer Drone item: They would cause a crash if they inflicted damage on enemies.

- Shopping: Swapping from using the mouse to using a gamepad could cause a crash when entering a shop.
